summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test plus a graph-unchanged check. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) under the shared venv Python. Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy, ruff, black and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Two lines are over 88 columns only because of a trailing type-ignore pragma.
